sketches.mechanism: The `object` keyword creates a singleton — exactly one instance can ever exist, enforced by the compiler.
sketches.resonance: Declaring grief as an object means there is only ever one grief; it cannot be instantiated again, cannot be copied, cannot be multiplied — it simply persists, singular and permanent.

sketches.mechanism: method_missing is called when an object receives a message it has no handler for; returning self creates an object that silently absorbs every unknown call.
sketches.resonance: An object that responds to anything said to it by simply returning itself is the mechanism of someone who has stopped listening — present but unreachable, echoing only themselves.
sketches.draft:
class After
  def method_missing(*)
    self
  end
  def respond_to_missing?(*)
    true
  end
end

After.new.are_you_there?.please.come_back

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no match exists on the right, filling unmatched columns with NULL.
sketches.resonance: The query asks for every person paired with who stayed — and the NULLs that come back are the shape of absence, structurally present but empty.
sketches.draft:
SELECT everyone.name,
       who_stayed.name
FROM   everyone
LEFT JOIN who_stayed
ON     everyone.id = who_stayed.id
